name: O'BRIEN, Llewellyn (Llew) Stephen

headline.note: Official chronology supports care, labour/factory work and police service. Follow-up identifies farm wage work and a2015Kilkivan police posting, but unnamed early employers have unknown control. Police cessation is only2016, with an extended absence and no hours/leave allocation. Unpaid care, study, patronage, party roles and elected office are excluded; public/private full-time totals remain null.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography lists carer from 1988 to 1989. Biographical accounts explain that O'Brien left school at 15 to care full-time for his mother after a motor-neurone-disease diagnosis until her death about a year later. No wages or formal employer are identified.
career_spells.counting_note: Explicitly full-time family care; unpaid_work exclusion remains. No paid full-time years counted.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official records give an aggregate labourer interval. Employers, industries, role boundaries, hours, leave, gaps and exact dates remain unidentified. Maiden speech describes wage work on farms and in factories during late teens/early twenties and difficulty finding jobs. This supplies farm-work context without named employers, exact spells or continuous employment. Do not infer private ownership from occupation.
career_spells.counting_note: Occupation and year range alone do not establish private control or continuous full-time work.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official records give an aggregate factory process-operator interval. Employer, industry, location, hours, leave and exact transition into policing are unpublished.
career_spells.counting_note: The occupation does not establish employer control or a continuous full-time interval.

career_spells.role: Police officer, including criminal-intelligence and traffic-accident investigation
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biography gives Queensland police service from 1999 to 2016, and medals corroborate at least 15 years' service. Member biographies identify 16 years in Wide Bay and specialties in criminal intelligence and traffic-accident investigation. O'Brien's first speech says PTSD following fatal-crash work led to more than a year before he returned to duty. Exact appointment, rank history, hours, leave dates/status and cessation before the 2 July 2016 election are not published. Follow-up: ABC12November2015 identifies him as a Kilkivan police officer. Election day was not a sourced police cessation date and is removed. Rank and posting dates remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: The service is public, but the known extended absence and missing hours/exact dates prevent treating the full calendar interval as countable full-time work.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biography gives Wide Bay chair2010–14. Separate from2015–16state vice-presidency; no continuous2010–16party employment inferred. Paid status/hours unknown.
Official records show election to the House of Representatives for Wide Bay on 2 July 2016.

research_notes: Identify every 1990–96 labouring employer and 1996–99 factory employer, industry, role boundary, hours, leave and exact dates; do not assume private ownership from occupation alone.
Obtain QPS appointment, posting/rank, hours, leave and cessation records, especially dates and paid/unpaid status of the absence exceeding one year after PTSD.
Resolve the 1999 factory-to-police and 2016 police-to-Parliament transitions without assuming day-level continuity.
Confirm paid status, hours and exact dates for LNP division-chair and vice-president roles; party work remains excluded.

Follow-up2026-10-02: reread first speech and primary biography; searched both engines for factory/farm employers, police rank and QPS/myPolice history. Farm wage work and2015Kilkivan posting added; no named early employer or police roster/pay/leave evidence located. Search results about MPs visiting factories are not evidence they worked there.

Further needs: named1990–99employers, government control, individual spell boundaries/hours; QPS appointment/cessation and leave records; training providers/attendance dates; patron appointment periods. Avoid repeating broad occupation searches without new leads. Election date no longer substituted for police resignation;2010–14and2015–16party roles separated.
